an4.124:1.1: cattārome bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
an4.124:1.3: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.124:1.4: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṃkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati
an4.124:1.5: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā suddhāvāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati
an4.124:1.6: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave upapatti asādhāraṇā puthujjanehi.
an4.124:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco puggalo vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.124:2.2: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṃkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati
an4.124:2.3: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā suddhāvāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati
an4.124:2.4: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave upapatti asādhāraṇā puthujjanehi.
an4.124:2.5: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
